zh-CN.title: 聊天更多操作更连贯
items: 折叠输入框从下方展开更多操作，展开输入框使用浮动菜单，布局切换与其他操作并列
足迹菜单直接显示公开或停止共享，去掉重复的中间页面

en.title: More consistent composer actions
items: Compact composers expand tools below; expanded composers use a popover with layout switching alongside other actions
Footprint menus show sharing permissions directly without an extra page
